lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-requests-ssrf-missing-private-ip-validation
title: User-supplied watch URL accepted or fetched without private/reserved IP (SSRF) validation
summary: 'URL validation and fetching code accepts a user-supplied URL without resolving the host and
  rejecting private, loopback, link-local or reserved addresses. The fetcher also follows redirects automatically,
  so an open redirect on a public host can reach internal targets. An attacker can add a watch for http://169.254.169.254/
  or http://127.0.0.1/ and read cloud metadata or internal services (server-side request forgery).

  '
cwe:
- CWE-918
severity: high
confidence: low
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: fe7aa38c651d73fe5f41ce09855fa8f97193747b
  vulnerable_ref: fe7aa38c651d73fe5f41ce09855fa8f97193747b^
  patched_ref: fe7aa38c651d73fe5f41ce09855fa8f97193747b
  repository: https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io
rule:
  message: 'URL is accepted or fetched without a check that its host resolves to a public address, or
    redirects are

    followed automatically. Resolve the host and block private/loopback/link-local/reserved IPs (unless
    explicitly

    allowed), re-check at fetch time, and follow redirects manually, validating each hop.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - patterns:
    - pattern: return True
    - pattern-inside: "def $F($URL, ...):\n    ...\n"
    - metavariable-regex:
        metavariable: $F
        regex: .*(safe|valid).*url.*|.*url.*(safe|valid).*
    - pattern-not-inside: "def $F(...):\n    ...\n    if not strtobool(os.getenv('ALLOW_IANA_RESTRICTED_ADDRESSES',\
        \ ...)):\n        ...\n    ...\n"
  - pattern: "if not is_safe_valid_url($U):\n    flash(...)\n    return None\n"
  - patterns:
    - pattern-inside: '$S = requests.Session()

        ...

        '
    - pattern: $S.request(..., url=$URL, ...)
    - pattern-not: $S.request(..., allow_redirects=False, ...)
fix:
  guidance: 'Add an is_private_hostname helper that resolves the hostname with getaddrinfo and returns
    True for private, loopback, link-local or reserved addresses, failing closed when resolution fails.
    Call it from is_safe_valid_url when a watch is added, and again at fetch time in the requests fetcher
    so DNS rebinding is covered. Skip the check only when the ALLOW_IANA_RESTRICTED_ADDRESSES environment
    variable is explicitly true. Send fetches with allow_redirects=False, follow redirects manually with
    a hop limit, and validate each redirect target before following it.

    '
  example: "# validate_url.py, at the end of is_safe_valid_url()\nif not strtobool(os.getenv('ALLOW_IANA_RESTRICTED_ADDRESSES',\
    \ 'false')):\n    parsed = urlparse(test_url)\n    if parsed.hostname and is_private_hostname(parsed.hostname):\n\
    \        return False\nreturn True\n\n# requests fetcher\nr = session.request(method=method, url=url,\
    \ headers=headers,\n                    timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=False)\nfor _ in range(10):\n\
    \    if not r.is_redirect:\n        break\n    url = urljoin(url, r.headers.get('Location', ''))\n\
    \    if not allow_restricted and is_private_hostname(urlparse(url).hostname):\n        raise Exception(\"\
    Redirect blocked\")\n    r = session.request('GET', url, headers=headers,\n                      \
    \  timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=False)\n"
